results.title: ASUS PB278Q (PXL 20250914 223256075).jpg
results.desc: An ASUS PB278Q computer monitor displaying the Wikipedia multi-language homepage. The monitor is running at its native 2560x1440 resolution. Firefox is showing wikipedia.org at 200% zoom in fullscreen mode running on Arch Linux. Also visible in the photo below the monitor is a Fosi Audio K5 Pro stereo DAC, a Kinivo 501BN HDMI switch, the 4-button wired remote controller for a Kceve-brand 4x4 USB 3.0 switcher, and a Lepy LP-2020A stereo amplifier. Micca-brand bookshelf speakers are partially visible on either side of the monitor, and a Keychron K8 keyboard and Anker USB hub are just barely visible in the edges of the frame. All of this is on top of a LTT Northern Lights Desk Pad.
